## Context

F48 is approved. The vendored Jira Data Center Dockerfile names an upstream path but omits the source revision, license identifier, protected license text, and modification statement. The upstream root `LICENSE` at commit `e3c7b167b065660605645cef7f101cbb324772e4` has SHA-256 digest `a432e25d7fa27b288cc7ab6ea8e3a9aa27c101579de7fad7a3b5f534ba9e772a`.

## Plan

- Update the comment header in `tests/external/live_jira_dc/Dockerfile` with the `pycontribs/jira` repository, commit `e3c7b167b065660605645cef7f101cbb324772e4`, source path `docker/jira-test-image/Dockerfile`, and license identifier `BSD-2-Clause`.
- State that the local copy adds `-Dproduct.start.timeout=2700000` and expanded operational annotations while retaining the pinned base digest, Jira version, exposed port, and `-DskipAllPrompts=true`.
- Store the pinned upstream root `LICENSE` bytes unchanged in `tests/external/live_jira_dc/pycontribs-jira-LICENSE.txt`.
- Add an upstream source licensing subsection to `tests/external/live_jira_dc/README.md`. Point it to the stored license text and distinguish that source license from Atlassian product licensing.
- Preserve the existing Atlassian product licensing paragraph.
- Add a unit assertion in `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_dc_harness_shape.py` that hashes the stored license bytes and compares them with the literal expected digest `a432e25d7fa27b288cc7ab6ea8e3a9aa27c101579de7fad7a3b5f534ba9e772a`. The assertion uses no network service or Jira harness.
- Preserve every Dockerfile instruction.
- Add no mechanical prose or character scanner.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Provenance names the exact repository, revision, source path, and `BSD-2-Clause` identifier.
- [x] `tests/external/live_jira_dc/pycontribs-jira-LICENSE.txt` has SHA-256 digest `a432e25d7fa27b288cc7ab6ea8e3a9aa27c101579de7fad7a3b5f534ba9e772a`.
- [x] The modification statement identifies the added timeout flag and expanded annotations.
- [x] Dockerfile instructions, base digest, Jira version, and entrypoint remain unchanged.
- [x] The existing Atlassian product licensing paragraph remains unchanged.
- [x] The default unit tier checks the pinned license digest without network or Docker access.
- [x] No connected Jira Data Center harness runs during verification.
- [x] Focused Dockerfile, license, lint, type, and whitespace checks pass.

## Verification

- Run `shasum -a 256 tests/external/live_jira_dc/pycontribs-jira-LICENSE.txt` and compare the result with `a432e25d7fa27b288cc7ab6ea8e3a9aa27c101579de7fad7a3b5f534ba9e772a`.
- Run `pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_dc_harness_shape.py`.
- Compare the Dockerfile noncomment instructions before and after the change.
- Run the repository lint, type, and whitespace checks without starting the connected Jira Data Center harness.
